faqs.q: Is Bardeen still a browser automation tool?
faqs.a: Bardeen now presents itself as a sales prospecting tool: an AI web scraper that finds and qualifies leads and adds contact details.
Bardeen gives 100 free credits. Basic is $10 a month for 100 credits, and Premium is $50 a month.

faqs.q: Which Bardeen alternative works in a browser?
faqs.a: Gumloop has a cloud browser with saved logins, Lindy drives a browser on Pro, and 50agents runs browser agents on a schedule.

faqs.q: Can I keep my Bardeen results?
faqs.a: Yes. Results download as CSV at no cost, or go to Google Sheets, Airtable or Notion.

faqs.q: What does a row cost on Bardeen?
faqs.a: Credits are charged per row: 1 for scraping or web search, 3 for enrichment, so Basic's 100 credits enrich about 33 leads.

faqs.q: Which alternative has a free plan?
faqs.a: Bardeen always gives 100 free credits, and unused ones expire each billing period. 50agents is free to start. Gumloop has no free plan.
Bardeen is built for prospecting, with ready-made scrapers and contact enrichment. 50agents browser agents read websites on a schedule and leave a report.
